neighbours.label: the tokens ' square' / ' squared' (raising to the second power, square units) and ' plural'
fire: The apartment covers about ninety square meters on one floor.
To get the area, the side length is squared and then doubled.
Each tile measures thirty centimeters square, so we needed many.
Her BMI is weight divided by height squared, in metric units.
In English, most nouns form the plural by adding an s.
The garden plot was sold at twelve dollars per square foot.
If you take three squared you get nine, as the teacher showed.
The Hebrew text uses the plural form where the Greek is singular.
quiet: The apartment covers about ninety meters of hallway on one floor.
To get the perimeter, the side length is doubled and then added.
Each tile measures thirty centimeters across, so we needed many.
Her BMI is weight divided by height, a crude metric in practice.
In English, most verbs form the past tense by adding ed.
The garden plot was sold at twelve dollars per running meter.
If you take three times two you get six, as the teacher showed.
The Hebrew text uses the feminine form where the Greek is neuter.
